title.suggested: 1869 sport notes mention Allen's fights with Gallagher and McCoole

summary.suggested: The Kansas City Times reprinted June 1869 notes on the Hickey-King prize fight, which mention that Charley Gallagher had lately beaten Tom Allen and recall disgraceful scenes at the Allen-McCoole fight.

metadata.notes: No page image; date and paper could not be checked against a masthead. The notes themselves are dated June 1869 from the Kansas City Daily Times.

facts.fact: Charley Gallagher had lately beaten Tom Allen, and was expected in Kansas City for the Hickey-King stakes deposit
The Allen-McCoole fight of 1869 was marked by disgraceful scenes

notes: The old summary says 1860; the notes are from 1869. Most of the column is about Hickey and King and the Jackson baseball club.
